title: Give a useful chart room to read
audience: Project leads reviewing weekly signup activity
outcome: Add a populated signup chart, widen it, and share a read-only view.

scenes.before: The Fieldnote overview shows two populated weekly trends and room to add another chart.
scenes.during: A chart title is entered and the new seven-day sign-ups chart appears in the grid.
scenes.after: Weekly sign-ups is visible with a populated trend from 36 to 62.
scenes.say: Fieldnote opens on a board with two populated trends. I’m adding a weekly sign-ups chart, naming it clearly, and checking its fresh seven-day view so a project lead can spot the change without leaving this page.
scenes.learn: A named, populated chart gives the team a useful baseline on the existing board.
scenes.next: Widen the new chart so its trend is easier to read alongside the existing reports.

actions.spokenAnchor: I’m adding a weekly sign-ups chart

scenes.before: The new chart is populated in a compact card, below the existing weekly visits and completed-task charts on the same overview.
scenes.during: The resize handle moves to the Wide target and the chart spans both grid columns.
scenes.after: The sign-ups line fills the wider card, and the earlier visit and task charts remain part of the overview.
scenes.say: Now I’m widening Weekly sign-ups so its seven-day line has room to read; the visits and completed-task trends stay nearby for comparison.
scenes.learn: A wider chart gives the rising line more room without removing earlier evidence from the board.
scenes.next: Share the finished board as a read-only view.

scenes.before: The completed overview shows the populated, full-width sign-ups chart and its neighboring trends.
scenes.during: A read-only link is created and opened in the browser.
scenes.after: The shared page shows the same synthetic chart and identifies the view as read-only, with editing controls absent.
scenes.say: The chart is ready to share, so I’m creating a read-only link and opening the shared view to confirm the same data is visible without editing controls.
scenes.learn: The finished result can be reviewed without exposing editing controls.
scenes.next: The viewer can now review the weekly trend on the shared board.

actions.spokenAnchor: The chart is ready to share

assertions.value: This is a read-only shared view of the sample workspace.
